items.title: Pay invoice for hearing aids (co-payment)
items.quote: Den Betrag erbitten wir innerhalb von 30 Tagen nach Rechnungsdatum auf unser Konto;
items.computation: Invoice date (Rechnungsdatum) is 19.11.2026. The period 'innerhalb von 30 Tagen nach Rechnungsdatum' runs from the day after the invoice date under § 187 Abs. 1 BGB, so day 1 = 20.11.2026. Counting 30 days forward (§ 188 Abs. 1 BGB), day 30 = 19.12.2026. 19.12.2026 is a Saturday; under § 193 BGB the deadline moves to the next business day, Monday 21.12.2026, which is not a public holiday in NRW. Final due date: 21.12.2026.

warnings: The invoice offers 'Ratenzahlung ... nach Absprache' (installment payment by arrangement) but gives no details on how to request it — the recipient should contact the sender directly if they want to use this option rather than relying on the letter alone.

No legal remedy / objection instructions (Rechtsbehelfsbelehrung) are present, which is normal for a private invoice but means there is no formal appeal path if the amount is disputed — any dispute about the 1.380,00 € Mehrkostenvereinbarung should be raised directly with the provider.
